post.message: LLM judge reported the PR title claims a fix that the changed non-test code does not plausibly exercise. Deterministic checks did not fire, but the judge's reading of intent vs. diff disagrees.
post.judgeRationale: The PR adds `#applyForwardedHeaders()` method to `FetchState` that resolves X-Forwarded-* headers when `allowedDomains` is configured, and modifies the request creation pipeline to skip header validation in `createRequestFromNodeRequest()` so that validation happens later in `FetchState`, allowing user-provided fetch handlers to set these headers before they are processed.
